content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the premature clearing of the skb's status area and the storage of the dev_cmd into it before the frame was fully committed to the transport layer. This led to issues with frames not being sent out after being deferred due to DQA (Dynamic Queue Allocation). Specifically, the driver_data[0] field was not restored correctly after being modified by the A-MSDU (Aggregate MAC Service Data Unit) logic, which resulted in incorrect handling of the skb's status and driver data. The patch defers these operations until just before the frame is handed to the transport, ensuring that the skb's status is correctly set up at the right time.
